core.title: Urn Tip Cabinet Door Pull, RK International CP-33

text.description_html:
RK International CP-33, Decorative Urn Tip Cabinet Pull

Decidedly fancy without being ornate, the Urn Tip Cabinet Door Pull made by RK International is the perfect choice for anyone who likes glamor. The decorative tip adds drama to this cabinet pull in a beautiful way. Made out of solid brass, it is available in satin nickel, polished brass, and oil rubbed bronze finishes. This decorative pull has a 3 inch center to center and a 5 inch overall length.

Specifications and Features of the RK International CP-33 3" Traditional Cabinet Pull:

  • Material: Brass
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 3"
  • Overall Length: 5-1/8"
  • Width: 1/2"
  • Projection: 7/8"
  • Screw: 1" long #8 - 32 machine screw.
  • Packaged with all necessary installation hardware.

Sold Individually
